props.name: open
props.description: Initial open state.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible title (required).

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting message shown under the title.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label for the input.

props.name: value
props.description: Initial / current value.

props.name: required
props.description: Require a non-empty value: the confirm button stays disabled while blank.

props.name: confirmValue
props.description: Type-to-confirm: when set, the confirm button stays disabled until the input matches this exact value — e.g. typing a file name to confirm its deletion.

props.name: confirmVariant
props.description: Variant of the confirm button (`"danger"` for a destructive confirm).

props.name: urgent
props.description: Interrupting urgency: switches the panel to `role="alertdialog"`, which screen readers announce immediately. Nothing else changes (ADR 0005).

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called with the entered value when confirmed (before the dialog closes).

props.name: closeOnOutsideClick
props.description: Whether pressing the backdrop cancels and closes. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the open state changes.

props.name: triggerVariant
props.description: Visual variant for the trigger Button.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The trigger button's label. The `trigger` slot replaces it with markup.
